summary.text: RAUDEBERG MAT AS is a private limited company registered in Raudeberg, founded 2015-03-03. RAUDEBERG MAT AS operates and owns grocery stores, and also engages in other relevant investment. Its main industry code is 47.110: non-specialised retail sale of predominately food, beverages or tobacco. The register shows 12 employees and 1 registered workplace. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 29 474 587 NOK and the annual result was 1 174 394 NOK; operating income was up from 28 169 243 NOK in 2024. The annual result rose from 772 900 NOK in 2024 to 1 174 394 NOK in 2025. Equity rose from 6 232 049 NOK in 2024 to 7 106 443 NOK in 2025. The registered employee count went from 16 on 2026-02-13 to 12 on 2026-10-14. The register's most recent update was on 2026-10-14 (antallAnsatte, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteEnhetsregisteret, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteNAVAaregisteret).
